questions.text: The platform would hold {{clinic}}'s old records as read-only history on each person: client details from the old client system, and every past appointment, with the practitioner's notes, from the old booking system. Should it?
How long should these old treatment notes be kept?
If a former client asks to be erased, should the platform delete their old treatment notes along with everything else it holds about them?
